{{nihongo|Tenjinsha|天神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}} located in {{ill|Itoshima|en|Itoshima, Fukuoka|qid=Q1011145|lt=Itoshima City}}, {{ill|Fukuoka Prefecture|en|Fukuoka Prefecture|qid=Q123258|lt=Fukuoka Prefecture}}, dedicated to [[Amaterasu]].

According to legend, when {{ill|Empress Jingū|en|Empress Jingū|qid=Q232803|lt=Empress Jingū}} was on her way to the [[Conquest of the Three Han]], she saw mist drifting between *Tenjinyama* (Tenjin Mountain) and *Takagamine* (Miyajidake) and interpreted it as an auspicious sign, exclaiming, "There is a divine presence here." Because of this, *Amaterasu Ōmikami* was enshrined on Tenjin Mountain.

Originally, the shrine was a private shrine (*tainai-sha*) of a former [[Ise Grand Shrine]] priest's residence. However, in the Heisei era, it was relocated to its current site.
